issues.on_page: State 2,907,793 (Exhibit B p3); Property tax credit 520,927 (p1), Homestead exemption payments 59,598 (p2), Prorate motor vehicle 11,415 (p2) are printed only as Exhibit A general receipts
issues.issue: The State line (receipts[5]-[8]) is split using Exhibit A general-receipt amounts, but no page prints a breakdown of the Exhibit B 'State' line itself, so it is an assumption that all three pieces sit in State. The arithmetic holds (520,927 + 59,598 + 11,415 + 2,315,853 = 2,907,793), but Exhibit A's 'Carline and airline tax' 11,931 (a user top-level category, Carline Tax), probably also in State, was not split out the same way. The extractor says this matches FY2023.

issues.on_page: Visitors Promotion 990: Taxes 17,244; Exhibit A p1 prints the same 17,244 as 'Other taxes'
issues.issue: The same 17,244 is category 'other taxes' in receipts[3] and 'lodging tax' in detail (fund name). The categories don't match within the report, and the rules say a printed tax-type label beats a fund name.
